about: Heroes shown only as a greyed-out "coming soon" tile in character select, before their kit is in the sheets (a hero with a kit uses heroes.json; release.json comingSoon greys it out). Nothing of a teaser is read from Deadlock but its select-screen portrait (imageSmall), blacked out to a silhouette. Move the hero to heroes.json (and remove its row here) when its kit lands.
